messages:
maria_sales: Orchid Health is ready to sign a reserved commit but legal pushed back on our sizing assumptions. Need a short ops + pricing checklist they can approve today.

tony_sre: What numbers did presales use? rps and avg tokens?

maria_sales: Presales quoted 48 rps peak, 30 rps steady, ~115 tokens per request. Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q (quantized). Contract shows 25M tokens/month commit.

ida_infra: Quick calc: peak token rate = 48 * 115 = 5520 tps -> ~477M tokens/day if sustained. 25M/month commit is orders of magnitude smaller. We should offer two clear options: (A) steady-reserve sized to 30 rps + overage billing, (B) peak-reserve sized to 48 rps with explicit burst-credit buffer and fallback routing.

tony_sre: Agree. Ops checklist to include: autoscale policy, preheat guidance for KV cache, smoke test plan, and BYOK/KMS lead time. For KV warmup recommend 4-6h default.

sam_fin: Finance: I will prepare two worked examples showing monthly reserved fee + token overage for (A) and GPU-hour burst credit costs for (B). Need a conservative preheat amortization line.

jen_prod: Suggest including a short routing policy and a YAML autoscale snippet in the MSA so legal can see exact behavior when pool is exhausted.

ida_infra: Autoscale snippet (shareable):
```yaml
autoscaling_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas_reserved: 12
  scale_step: 1
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  burst_pool: hosted-burst
```

tony_sre: Security quick answers to include: BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private (48-72h integration), region restriction supported (us-east-1/eu-west-1), audit logs exportable to S3, SOC2 report available on request.

maria_sales: Action items: Ill confirm they meant 25M/month and request an anonymized 24h traffic dump under NDA. Ida to run perf sims on H100/A100 and post rps->GPU table in 48h. Sam to circulate pricing scenarios Monday. Jen to draft the one-page runbook (sizing matrix, autoscale snippet, routing fallback, security bullets).

ida_infra: noted. Ill also include preheat GPU-hour estimate for 4h and 6h windows and a short note on cold-miss tail risk if preheat <4h.

tony_sre: I'll own the staging smoke (2h at 80% peak + preheat). If we get the traffic sample we can finalize reserve recommendation.

maria_sales: Thanks team  will update when customer confirms. :v:
